## Supplementary Fig. 3a
```{r, results='hide', fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}

# Compare number of interactions (count) and interaction strength (weight)
gg1 <- compareInteractions(cc.merged, show.legend = F, group = c(1,2,3))
gg2 <- compareInteractions(cc.merged, show.legend = F, group = c(1,2,3), measure = "weight")

p <- (gg1 | gg2) &
  theme_classic() &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1, lineend = "square"),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1, lineend = "square"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(6, "pt")
  )
ggsave(file.path(save.path, "CCC_number_intensity_barplot.pdf"), p, width = 7, height=4)
p
```

## Supplementary fig. 3c, d, e, f
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide', fig.width = 9.9, fig.height=3.5}
cellchat_list <- qread("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/cellchat_list.qs")


`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# ---- helper: get pathway matrix (netP$prob) ----
get_pathway_mat <- function(cc, pathway) {
  m <- cc@netP$prob[, , pathway]
  m <- as.matrix(m)
  m[is.na(m)] <- 0
  m
}

# ---- helper: combine heatmaps ----
combine_ht <- function(ht_list) Reduce(`+`, ht_list)

# ---- main: heatmap with fixed top/right bar ylim (NO rescaling) ----
netVisual_heatmap_fixed_lims <- function(
    cc,
    pathway,
    title.name = NULL,
    color.heatmap = "Reds",
    color.use = NULL,
    remove.isolate = FALSE,
    cluster.rows = FALSE,
    cluster.cols = FALSE,
    top_ylim = c(0, 10),       # top bar fixed range
    right_ylim = c(0, 10),     # right bar fixed range (anno_barplot uses ylim here too)
    heatmap_max = NULL,        # fix heatmap color scale across conditions if desired
    legend.name = "Communication Prob.",
    show_bar_axis = TRUE,
    bar_axis_fontsize = 7
) {
  mat <- get_pathway_mat(cc, pathway)
  
  # optional: remove isolates
  if (remove.isolate) {
    idx1 <- which(Matrix::rowSums(mat) == 0)
    idx2 <- which(Matrix::colSums(mat) == 0)
    idx  <- intersect(idx1, idx2)
    if (length(idx) > 0) mat <- mat[-idx, -idx, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  # colors for cell groups
  if (is.null(color.use)) {
    color.use <- CellChat::scPalette(ncol(mat))
    names(color.use) <- colnames(mat)
  } else {
    if (is.null(names(color.use))) names(color.use) <- colnames(mat)
    color.use <- color.use[colnames(mat)]
  }
  
  # fixed heatmap color scale
  if (is.null(heatmap_max)) heatmap_max <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  heatmap_max <- max(heatmap_max, 1e-12)
  pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, color.heatmap)
  col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, heatmap_max, length.out = length(pal)), pal)
  
  # group annotation bars (left & bottom)
  df <- data.frame(group = colnames(mat))
  rownames(df) <- colnames(mat)
  
  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = df, col = list(group = color.use), which = "column",
    show_legend = FALSE, show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )
  row_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = df, col = list(group = color.use), which = "row",
    show_legend = FALSE, show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )
  
  # axis params: use gp (NOT labels_gp) to be compatible with more ComplexHeatmap versions
  top_axis_param <- if (show_bar_axis) {
    list(at = top_ylim, labels = top_ylim, gp = gpar(fontsize = bar_axis_fontsize))
  } else NULL
  
  right_axis_param <- if (show_bar_axis) {
    list(at = right_ylim, labels = right_ylim, gp = gpar(fontsize = bar_axis_fontsize))
  } else NULL
  
  # TOP bar (vertical) -> ylim
  ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(
      Matrix::colSums(abs(mat)),
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = color.use, col = color.use),
      ylim = top_ylim,
      axis_param = top_axis_param
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )
  
  # RIGHT bar -> anno_barplot still uses ylim to control range
  ha_right <- rowAnnotation(
    Strength = anno_barplot(
      Matrix::rowSums(abs(mat)),
      border = FALSE,
      gp = gpar(fill = color.use, col = color.use),
      ylim = right_ylim,
      axis_param = right_axis_param
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )
  
  # show zeros as white (visual only)
  mat_plot <- mat
  if (sum(abs(mat_plot) > 0, na.rm = TRUE) != 1) mat_plot[mat_plot == 0] <- NA
  
  Heatmap(
    mat_plot,
    col = col_fun,
    na_col = "white",
    name = legend.name,
    bottom_annotation = col_anno,
    left_annotation   = row_anno,
    top_annotation    = ha_top,
    right_annotation  = ha_right,
    cluster_rows = cluster.rows,
    cluster_columns = cluster.cols,
    column_title = title.name %||% paste0(pathway, " signaling network"),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_names_rot = 90,
    row_title = "Sources (Sender)",
    row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    row_title_rot = 90,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    row_title_side = "left",
    row_names_side = "left"
  )
}

# =========================
# CALLING + SAVING CODE
# =========================

pathways.show.list <- c("COLLAGEN", "LAMININ", "FN1", "TENASCIN")


# per-pathway custom limits
top_ylim_by_pathway <- list(
  COLLAGEN = c(0, 10),
  LAMININ  = c(0, 2),
  FN1      = c(0, 1),
  TENASCIN = c(0, 0.3)
)

right_xlim_by_pathway <- list(
  COLLAGEN = c(0, 4),
  LAMININ  = c(0, 1.5),
  FN1      = c(0, 0.8),
  TENASCIN = c(0, 0.2)
)


default_gap <- unit(0.5, "cm")

for (pathway in pathways.show.list) {
  
  top_ylim   <- top_ylim_by_pathway[[pathway]]   %||% c(0, 10)
  right_ylim <- right_xlim_by_pathway[[pathway]] %||% c(0, 10)
  
  # unify heatmap color scale across conditions for THIS pathway
  mats <- lapply(cellchat_list, get_pathway_mat, pathway = pathway)
  heatmap_max_global <- max(unlist(mats), na.rm = TRUE)
  heatmap_max_global <- max(heatmap_max_global, 1e-12)
  
  ht_list <- vector("list", length(cellchat_list))
  
  for (i in seq_along(cellchat_list)) {
    
    cond_name <- if (!is.null(names(cellchat_list)) && nzchar(names(cellchat_list)[i])) {
      names(cellchat_list)[i]
    } else {
      paste0("Condition_", i)
    }
    
    ht_list[[i]] <- netVisual_heatmap_fixed_lims(
      cc = cellchat_list[[i]],
      pathway = pathway,
      title.name = paste0(pathway, " signaling: ", cond_name),
      color.heatmap = "Reds",
      top_ylim = top_ylim,
      right_ylim = right_ylim,
      heatmap_max = heatmap_max_global,   # same color scale across conditions
      show_bar_axis = TRUE,
      bar_axis_fontsize = 7
    )
  }
  
  pdf(
    file = file.path(save.path, paste0("netVisual_heatmap_", pathway, ".pdf")),
    width = 3.3 * length(ht_list),
    height = 3.5
  )
  draw(combine_ht(ht_list), ht_gap = default_gap)
  dev.off()
  draw(combine_ht(ht_list), ht_gap = default_gap)
}
```
